shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated pattern running across the upper part of the surface
rectilinear framing lines enclosing a central field
shallow relief/incised linear carving on a flat slab-like surface
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry a horizontal band of repeated pattern and linear framing across a flat slab face, plus a small central motif in a bounded field. The decisive difference is that A is entirely abstract and rectilinear (nested frames, a cross-like sign, a tiny schematic glyph) while B is densely populated with figurative relief creatures — quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like body — arranged in registers, with no comparable figural content in A.
